title: agentcore-harness
description: Generate an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Harness project

name.description: The name of your AgentCore Harness project. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character which can be normalized into a kebab-case project name (eg. my-harness).
name.x-prompt: What would you like to call your AgentCore Harness?

directory.description: Parent directory where the harness project is placed. Defaults to packages. Must be a relative path which does not contain parent directory (..) segments.

subDirectory.description: The sub directory the project is placed in. Defaults to the kebab-case harness name. Must be a relative path which does not contain parent directory (..) segments.

modelId.description: The Amazon Bedrock model ID configured as the harness deployment default. Defaults to global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character when supplied.

systemPrompt.description: The system prompt configured as the harness deployment default. Defaults to: You are a helpful AI assistant. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character when supplied.

allowedTools.description: Allowed tool patterns configured as the harness deployment default. Defaults to a single @builtin pattern which enables AgentCore built-in tools. Accepts between 1 and 64 entries; every entry must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

maxIterations.description: Maximum number of agentic loop iterations for a harness invocation, as a positive integer. When omitted, the property is left unset on the harness resource and the AgentCore service default applies.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens for a harness invocation, as a positive integer. When omitted, the property is left unset on the harness resource and the AgentCore service default applies.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum harness execution time in seconds, as a positive integer. When omitted, the property is left unset on the harness resource and the AgentCore service default applies.

infra.description: The type of infrastructure to generate for hosting your harness. Defaults to agentcore. Select none for no hosting.
infra.x-prompt: How would you like to host your harness?

iac.description: The preferred IaC provider for generated harness infrastructure. Defaults to inherit, which uses the provider configured for your workspace.
iac.x-prompt: Which provider would you like to manage your infrastructure? (default: inherit)

preferInstallDependencies.description: Whether to prefer installing dependencies after the generator runs. Defaults to true. Set to false to defer installing when batching multiple generators (an install still runs if needed so subsequent generators can compute the Nx project graph); install once at the end.
